answer: At year-end 2025, permanent employees were 64,974 and temporary employees 4,531; their sum of 69,505 exactly matches disclosed headcount. For 2024, 68,669 plus 5,487 equals the disclosed 74,156 exactly. No employees were on non-guaranteed-hours contracts. The 2024 employee metrics, including the displayed FTE and headcount, exclude Catalent; including Catalent, headcount was 77,349.

evidence.quote: By end of 2025, Novo Nordisk employed 64,974 permanent and 4,531 temporary employees, similar to the 2024 split (68,669 permanent and 5,487 temporary).
No employees in Novo Nordisk’s own workforce are hired on non-guaranteed hours contracts.
All 2024 employee related metrics exclude Catalent
Including Catalent, FTE is 76,302 and headcount is 77,349.
